Aspera Connect — phone install via USB (bypasses Play Protect)
==============================================================

Use this when the phone shows:
  "App blocked to protect your device"  (only an OK button)

Google Play Protect hard-blocks some sideloaded apps. USB install works.

On the PC (Linux Mint / Ubuntu):

  1. Enable on the phone:
       Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times
       Settings → Developer options → USB debugging ON
  2. Plug phone into PC with USB cable → Allow USB debugging on phone
  3. Run:

       sudo apt install -y adb
       curl -L --http1.1 -o /tmp/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk \
         "https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk"
       adb install -r /tmp/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk

  4. On phone: open Aspera Connect → Start for calls

If adb says unauthorized: unlock phone → Allow this computer → try again.

After install you can turn USB debugging OFF again.
